methods: Latest CSB IRD081 2026-01-01 total persons, SEX=T and AgeGroup=TOTAL. National polygon archive failed after patient retry: bind only a single active literal own-item P1115 ATVK to the exact CSB AREA code, own Latvian/English name, town or state-city P31 and compatible row type. Direct active municipality P131, its ISO and ATVK prefix prove the same state, or own state-city ISO proves it. Review original point against own-item P625 within 1000 m as a conservative conflict screen; this is not polygon containment. No name-only DPA or municipal substitution. The owner explicitly authorized own ATVK binding when boundary unavailable. Hold unresolved identity keys, missing/conflicting codes, parents, scope, states or points. Preserve every stored field when same-entity count, licence or binding has not been proved.

Latest CSB IRD081 2026-01-01 total persons, SEX=T and AgeGroup=TOTAL. National polygon archive failed after patient retry: bind only a single active literal own-item P1115 ATVK to the exact CSB AREA code, own Latvian/English name, town or state-city P31 and compatible row type. Direct active municipality P131, its ISO and ATVK prefix prove the same state, or own state-city ISO proves it. Review original point against own-item P625 within 1000 m as a conservative conflict screen; this is not polygon containment. No name-only DPA or municipal substitution. The owner explicitly authorized own ATVK binding when boundary unavailable. Hold unresolved identity keys, missing/conflicting codes, parents, scope, states or points.

Retry published no-key files from the 2025 subnational estimates and 2023 Census releases. Inspect all workbook tables: regions, territorial authorities and Auckland boards do not supply an urban area or suburb total. Retain prior literal own-item, type, parent and original-point official-boundary screening as evidence only. All NZ edits held; no older, surrounding TA, regional or same-name SA2 total substituted. No key, account or access-block workaround. Preserve every stored field when same-entity count, licence or binding has not been proved.
